title: Higgsfield MCP: Credit Cost by Model (2026 Guide)
summary: Higgsfield MCP generates images and videos inside Claude, so you can create content without switching apps or copying prompts elsewhere.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


### Is Higgsfield MCP free to use?


No. Every generation spends credits, and the cost varies by model, so a rights check before the first generation also stops you paying for output you can't use.


Higgsfield publishes plan details and any free allowance on its own pricing page. I haven't confirmed current terms, so check there before you budget.


### Does Higgsfield MCP work in Claude Code as well as Claude chat?


Yes in principle, because both are MCP clients and can connect to a remote MCP server. The exact connection steps and authentication flow differ by client, and Higgsfield's setup documentation is the place to get them.


Test with one cheap generation first, so a misconfigured connection costs you little.


### Can I use Higgsfield MCP with ChatGPT or other clients?


If a client supports remote MCP servers, it should be able to connect, since MCP is an open protocol rather than an Anthropic feature.


Whether a given client's MCP support covers what Higgsfield needs is something I can't confirm, and Higgsfield hasn't published a compatibility list that I've verified. If your client is missing, that's the gap to ask the vendor about.


### Where do my generated files end up?


On the Higgsfield side, generations are tied to your account, and the agent gets results back through the MCP connection. I haven't found a published statement on storage location, retention period or download behavior, so don't assume files persist indefinitely.


Have the agent save or hand off each asset you intend to keep as part of the workflow, not as an afterthought.


### Do I need Activepieces to use Higgsfield MCP?


No. Connecting Higgsfield MCP to a compatible client works on its own, and you can generate from a conversation without any other automation tool.


Activepieces only becomes relevant when you want generated assets to flow into other apps on a schedule or trigger, which its MIT-licensed core handles without replacing Higgsfield's MCP.
